name: מַהֵר שָׁלָל חָשׁ בַּז
gloss: swift is the spoil, speedy is the plunder
summary: Isaiah writes the phrase before the child’s birth. He is then told to give it to his son because Assyria will carry away the wealth of Damascus and Samaria before the child can call for his parents.
note: The two clauses about spoil and plunder stand in parallel. The prophetic explanation makes their urgency clear.
